Original deterministic geometric RGB PNGs generated locally for this test. No user photos or third-party imagery. landscape.png: 160x100; portrait.png: 100x160; extreme-wide.png: 1000x1. corrupt.png deliberately contains invalid image bytes. The harness uses these local bytes, controlled cache streams or the actual disk CacheManager with a local FileService. No service opens an HTTP socket. Success assertions require decoded source pixel dimensions.
